meaning.en: Showing, or intended to excite, lust or sexual desire, esp. in an offensive way; lascivious.

meaning.en: Preoccupied with sex and sexual desire; lustful.

Đa dâm, lăng nhăng, thô lỗ.

meaning.en: The definition of lewd is offensive sexual behavior.

sentences.en: Suggestive or lewd comments can be offensive and detract from the occasion.While a wedding speech should be unique, there are some basic elements that you can incorporate to get you started.

sentences.en: Adult Material - Includes all pornography, erotic images, or otherwise lewd or obscene content.

sentences.en: You would think the first arrest for lewd acts would have taught the singer to keep his pants on, but in July 2006, George again made headlines, this time for reportedly enjoying a romp in a public park with a 58-year-old van driver.

sentences.en: However, it did feature some spicy language in LEWD mode.

sentences.en: However, such balls were seen as encouraging wild and lewd behavior, which was frowned upon in Victorian England.

sentences.en: Whether a riff off of the classic "There once was a girl from Nantucket" or perhaps a rhyme for your sweetheart's name, the limerick has been a treasured form of lewd expression for decades.
sentences.vi: Cho dù là một đoạn trích từ câu chuyện cổ điển ""Đã từng có một cô gái đến từ Nantucket"" hay có lẽ là một vần điệu cho tên người yêu của bạn, thì bức tranh vôi đã là một hình thức biểu đạt dâm dục đáng trân trọng trong nhiều thập kỷ.

sentences.en: Women find that they get more attention through ChatRoulette, though occasionally they are subjected to lewd suggestions.
sentences.vi: Phụ nữ nhận thấy rằng họ được chú ý nhiều hơn qua ChatRoulette, mặc dù đôi khi họ phải chịu những lời đề nghị dâm ô.

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the Toros cheerleaders respond quickly and in unison with an almost lewd cheer about pumping gas, and the other team is obviously outclassed.

sentences.en: Lisa Ellis has been teaching English for nine years, but the headmaster where she works found the behavior lewd and was looking into dismissing her from the job.
sentences.vi: Lisa Ellis đã dạy tiếng Anh được 9 năm, nhưng hiệu trưởng nơi cô làm việc phát hiện ra hành vi dâm ô và đang xem xét cách chức cô khỏi công việc.

sentences.en: Ross sang this one and his capacity for delivery outrageously lewd lyrics completely deadpan is always something to behold.
